solvents including DCM, DCE,

catalysts led to a lower yield (entry 1 vs. entries 14 and 15).

were necessary (entries 16 and 17). It is noteworthy that no
dimeric byproduct 2a′ was observed.11a

and 4-OH-TEMPO were found to
